feld.rationale: The Felds give about 12,500 a year. Without gifts their itemized deductions would be 28,831 (SALT 10,591 + mortgage interest 18,240), below the 31,500 standard deduction. From 2026, itemizers also lose the first 0.5% of AGI in gifts — about 2,990 at this year's AGI of 598,030. Giving two years of gifts (25,000) to a donor-advised fund in 2026 and taking the standard deduction in 2027 adds about 5,659 of deductions over the two years (the 2,990 floor is paid once, not twice, plus 2,669 more from the 2027 standard deduction): about 1,810 of federal tax at 32%.
